Open the [preserved-copy prototype](http://maker:4001/index.html?flow=archive&view=reader) and select **View saved copy** on the bookmark card. Tell me whether this preserved version would give you the confidence you meant by “it’ll still be there.”

This first version assumes the app keeps a clean reading copy of the page’s meaningful text and images, records when it was saved, and identifies the original address—even if that address later stops working.
